title: Dedicated temporal-fidelity load suite: burst + steady-state regression detector
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a reproducible load-test harness that validates dedicated capacity autoscaling behavior across temporal patterns: short high-intensity bursts (10-90s), mid-length surges (5-15m), and sustained steady-state (30m+). Focus metrics on tokens/sec throughput and p95 latency for tail detection and automatic regression gating. Deliverables: test runner config, telemetry ingestion schema, regression detector, and CI gating integration.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can replay three canonical profiles (microburst, surge, steady) against a dedicated pool using the same client-side seed inputs
Telemetry emitted includes tokens/sec (per-second), p50/p90/p95/p99 latencies, instance-level KV cache hit rate, and queue depth; metrics must be tagged with model_variant and region
Regression detector flags >10% tokens/sec degradation or >25% relative increase in p95 compared to baseline for two consecutive runs
Test runs are reproducible and can be executed in CI with synthetic load generator and smoke duration <45m
PRs that change runtime scheduling or batching kernels are automatically checked by the regression detector and blocked if a high-confidence regression is detected
test_plan: Define canonical input corpus (400 prompts) representative of enterprise workloads: chat turns, long completion seeds, and embeddings queries
Create three scenario definitions: (A) microburst: 1k rps for 30s then idle 300s repeat; (B) surge: ramp 0->600 rps over 90s hold 10min; (C) steady: constant 200 rps for 40min
Run each scenario against a 4-GPU dedicated pool and an equivalent 8-GPU pool to validate autoscaler setpoint behavior
Collect metrics from runtime exporter, Console ingest pipeline, and local agent logs; correlate request traces with batch formation and kernel selection logs
Evaluate regression using both delta thresholds and a Mann-Whitney U test for p95 distribution across runs to avoid brittle mean-based checks
harness_configs:
microburst:
  target_rps: 1000
  burst_window_s: 30
  idle_between_bursts_s: 300
  seed_set: corp_prompts_v2
run_results: 2026-03-11 trial against 4-GPU pool: microburst passed; observed tokens/sec spike matched target +/- 6%; p95 tail increased by 18% during burst but returned to baseline after 45s
2026-03-11 trial surge: autoscaler scaled from 2->6 nodes at 140s into ramp; observed oscillation at 9-11 minute mark correlated with scale-down aggressiveness (cooldown too short)
Telemetry note: KV cache hit rate telemetry was not labeled with model_variant in initial run; fixed tagging patch in PR #1327
Regression detection dry-run: detector flagged surge p95 increase of 28% vs baseline (high confidence) — run archived as ref-run 2026-03-11-01
notes_and_tradeoffs: Decision: use p95 as primary SLO for client-facing latency because p99 is too noisy for short bursts; keep p99 in secondary dashboards
Trade-off: choosing a non-parametric test (Mann-Whitney) reduces false positives for heavy-tailed latencies but requires more samples; mitigated by using repeated short runs
Operational constraint: running long steady-state tests is costly in Dedicated; added a reduced steady profile (40m -> 20m) for nightly CI where budget constrained
Fallback policy: if regression detector triggers in CI, block merge and trigger an autosmoke job that replays the failing scenario with full tracing enabled
action_items: D1: Diego to land tagging fix for KV cache telemetry (PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1327) — due 2026-03-13
D2: Build regression-detector microservice (stat test + effect-size heuristics) and deploy to staging — assign Diego, estimate 5 pts
D3: Add CI job 'dedicated-temporal-fidelity' to run microburst+surge as part of pre-merge for runtime changes — owner: SRE team
D4: Update Console dashboard template to surface tokens/sec heatmap and p95 control chart for test runs — owner: Observability team
next_steps: Complete regression-detector rollout to staging and validate false-positive rate <5% across 20 historical runs
Tune autoscaler cooldown to remove 10-15% oscillation observed in surge trial
Add synthetic longer-tail prompts to corpuses to better exercise KV cache and kernel-selection edge cases
Schedule cross-team review with Product and SRE (2026-03-16) to finalize CI gating thresholds
